title: 两数求和
problem_statement_md:
编写一个程序，输入两个数字。

将输入的数值赋值给变量**a**和**b**，然后输出它们的总和。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]User input[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Write a program that takes two numbers as input, assigns those values to the provided [b]a[/b] and [b]b[/b] variables, then outputs their [b]sum[/b].

[note]Use [b]cin[/b] for user input.[/note]
